name: Living parchment name banner
safe_text_box_units: normalized bottom-left UV: u_min, v_min, u_max, v_max
safe_text_box_px_units: top-left image pixels: x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max; max exclusive

motion_channels.G: right free tail and gentler upper curl weight, 0..1

motion_format: opaque RGB 8-bit linear numerical values; do not apply sRGB decoding
artwork_alpha: straight RGBA from image generation, preserved unchanged; alphaTest 0.5 recommended by bundled helper
mask_note: Fields extend into transparent surroundings; never multiply these weights by artwork opacity.
geometry_note: Deforming 2.5D illustrated plane, with unchanged UVs and a pinned central text rectangle. Not a real unfolding paper simulation.
source: Original reference-directed raster artwork. This package contains no SVG or separated reverse-face geometry.
